versions.changelog:
- Initial release of oschina-hot-trend skill.
- Enables search and summarization of open source projects and tech articles from 开源中国 (oschina.net).
- Provides project and article metadata extraction, trend statistics, and lightweight information aggregation.
- Designed for manual, individual page processing; avoids automated bulk scraping or reverse engineering.
- Includes clear guidance on task types, supported fields, and compliance boundaries.
